newsitem.title: CHINA: China textile group wins Syria mill project.
newsitem.headline: China textile group wins Syria mill project.

text.p: China Textile Industry Foreign Economic Cooperation Co has beaten nine competitors to win a major contract to build a cotton textile mill in Syria, the Shanghai Securities News said on Monday.
The mill would be built on Syria's Mediterranean coast and involved a total investment of $182.5 million, it said.

The Chinese company defeated competitors from countries such as Japan, Germany and France and the project was the biggest it had won. It proved that its textile equipment and machinery was of world standard, the newspaper said. It gave no more details.
